name: preamble-cycle-growth-controls
description: Preamble growth control in cyclic graphs (fabro-699f): two mechanisms compose with the existing stage envelope. (1) preamble_stages_latest_only=true on a node collapses repeated completed-node visits to each stage's LAST occurrence before build_preamble (node_outcomes is already id-latest, only the list dedups); render-only. (2) context_consume_keys=a,b on a node removes those keys from the durable Context in after_record, AFTER state.record applied updates and BEFORE edge selection; keys the stage itself re-emitted are spared (fresh outputs are not stale inputs). Placement matters: after_record ordering is state.record -> lifecycle.after_record -> resolve_next_step, so consumption is routing-visible if edges read consumed keys.
